interpretation: TF-IDF plus LSI has no checkpoint-corpus contamination and, unlike the pinned cisTopic release, supports an inductive transform for observed held ATAC rows. Leakage can still enter through the peak universe, Signac IDF, component count and exclusion, SVD fit/signs, labels, classifier, or calibration. The exact Signac method-1 formula is training-frozen and must not be replaced by a document-frequency variant. LSI remains ineligible for current sealed tasks because GSE289173 is RNA-only and LSI has neither RNA-conditioned ATAC generation nor a sequence/allele mechanism.
